records.title: Research and Development of Anti-G Life Support Systems. Part 2. Decompression Sickness Research
records.locator: Table 2, printed p. 9 (PDF p. 13) and Tables 7–8, printed p. 17 (PDF p. 21)
records.note: Table 2 in the technical report and Table I in Dixon give the same 30 subject numbers, three-day grade/site cells and one withdrawal after day-one DCS. The two publications report positive-day recurrence in nested risk sets. Table 7 prints a selected matrix by participant and pressure. The initial column pools nine people at 7.8 psia and seven at 8.0 psia. Dashes are unreported, not grade zero. The wider NEDU threshold compilation has different denominators.

threshold.pressure_discrepancy: At 10.0 psia Table 7 shows grades 1 and 2. The discussion describes the two observations as grade 1.
threshold.symptom_count_basis: Table 8 reports four positive symptom rows, with two limb-bends grades, one possible skin-bends row and one unclassified joint-awareness row. The table does not establish symptom-free status for unlisted cells.
